name: Alessandro Palliccia
line: Student of Mathematical Engineering at Politecnico di Milano.
description: Notes by Alessandro Palliccia: the courses of Mathematical Engineering at Politecnico di Milano, lecture by lecture, with interactive figures.
bio: I study Mathematical Engineering at Politecnico di Milano on the Statistical Learning track, after earning a degree in Computer Science. I am equally interested in understanding why machine learning models work and in making them run well on real hardware.
I am building SpikeFlow8, an inference engine that runs natively on AMD Ryzen AI chips and uses both their GPU and NPU. This site collects my notes as threads about what I study and build.
